# LevelUp Ecosystem

> LevelUp Ecosystem is a web design and development studio that builds fast, secure websites for local businesses, creators, and portfolios. Founded by Richelieu Bonte, a cybersecurity student, the studio uses AI-assisted development with human review on every project, and offers website security checks and ongoing care plans.

## Services
- Local business websites with online booking: /services/local-business-websites
- Creator and influencer websites: /services/creator-websites
- Portfolio websites: /services/portfolio-websites
- Online store setup: /services/online-stores
- Website security checks: /services/security-check
- Website care and maintenance plans: /services/care-plans

## Key pages
- Free website preview tool: /preview

## Facts
- Based in San Diego, California, serving clients across the United States and internationally.
- Founded by Richelieu Bonte.
- Uses AI tools for design and development, with human review before launch.
- Offers a free instant AI-generated preview and a custom preview built within 24 to 48 hours.
